$comment: The governed money policy (lib/money-policy.js, PR-049). The policy is a kernel node of `kind` in the platform namespace, named by `scheme`/`key`; its rules are the node's attributes, so every version is a row of the kernel's bitemporal k_versions (valid time: when a rule applies; recorded time: when it was believed). It changes only through the kernel's change lifecycle (lib/kernel-lifecycle.js): drafted, validated, previewed, approved by someone other than its author, published, rolled back. The first version is seeded from lib/seed/money.json (`rounding`, `currencies`), so a fresh install applies exactly the rule it always did. The rounding rules a policy may name are lib/money.js MODES; nothing here is code. `section` is the platform console section whose write grant may draft, approve, publish and roll back a policy change. `ref` prefixes the version reference every money row records (money_policy). `samples` are the amounts a preview rounds under the current and the proposed policy.
label: Money policy
